title: Convergence Rates of Tseng's Splitting Method and Its Acceleration Schemes for Monotone Inclusion Problem with a Sum of Hölder Continuous Operators
summary: The monotone inclusion problem is fundamental in applied mathematics and is closely related to a wide range of practical applications. However, existing solution methods typically require the underlying operator to be Lipschitz continuous. Recently, Hölder continuity, a weaker condition than Lipschitz continuity, has proven useful in characterizing certain real-world problems.
